feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 12:05pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales or severe gales.


##Synopsis##

Atlantic low (Storm Boelo) will become a very deep feature as it tracks northeastwards to the west of Scotland today.


##Wind##

South 7 or gale 8, occasionally severe gale 9 in west of area at first, veering West or Southwest 7 or gale 8 late afternoon or early evening. Increasing gale 8 or severe gale 9 late evening and tonight.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing later today.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavier rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, imminently decreasing 7 or gale 8, then 6 or 7 in evening, backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Monday, then southeast 6 or 7 later in the morning.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate or rough tomorrow evening, moderate overnight into Monday, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later.
